name: copper_2layer_default
note: Rules for Copper's two-layer router (src/v2_src/autoroute.c). They are Copper's design choices, not fabricator capabilities: `copper design route` refuses them (INVALID_INPUT) if any is below the limit of the fab profile it is given. Values are kept well above the minimums of fab_profiles/jlcpcb_2layer.json (JLCPCB capabilities page, retrieved 2026-11-06) so a board does not depend on the fab's tightest process.

grid_mm.why: routing grid pitch; fine enough to escape 1.27 mm pitch module pads, coarse enough to keep the grid small

track_mm.why: default signal track: 2.5x the profile's 0.10 mm minimum track width

clearance_mm.why: copper to copper of different nets: above every copper spacing minimum in the profile, the largest being PTH to track (0.28 mm)

edge_clearance_mm.why: copper to board outline: 2.5x the profile's 0.20 mm minimum (routed edge)

via_size_mm.why: via pad diameter: above the profile's 0.25 mm minimum and 0.3 mm larger than the hole (profile: at least 0.10 mm)

via_drill_mm.why: via hole: 2x the profile's 0.15 mm minimum via hole

via_cost.why: a via costs as much as 8 grid steps, so the router changes layer only when it saves length or is needed

passes.why: rip-up-and-reroute passes: nets that fail are routed first in the next pass

max_cells.why: grid cells per layer the router may use (a 500 mm x 500 mm board at 0.25 mm)

fine_pitch_clearance_mm.why: Step 3c, LAYOUT_RULES.md R5: only between a fine-pitch pad's escape stub and the other SMD pads of its own footprint (a footprint whose own pads are closer than clearance_mm, e.g. SOT-563 0.15 mm, USB-C 0.20 mm). Equal to the profile's SMD pad-to-pad minimum (0.15 mm), above its pad-to-track minimum (0.10 mm); copper design route refuses it below any of them

fine_pitch_neck_mm.why: escape stub width at fine-pitch pads: no wider than the narrowest fine-pitch pad in the library (0.30 mm, USB-C), and stubs of neighbouring pads at 0.5 mm pitch keep the full clearance_mm between them (0.5 - 0.2 = 0.3); 2x the profile's 0.10 mm minimum track
